## Common Support (PCA) and Balance (Love Plots)

```{r}
#| label: diagnostic-functions

# --- 0. Shared Theme Text Configuration ---
shared_text_theme <- theme(
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray30", size = 12),
  panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.22),
  axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14), 
  axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
  legend.title = element_blank()
)

# 1. Distribution / Overlap Plots
gerar_dist_overlap <- function(match_obj, var_name, strata_name, method_label, font_family = "sans", 
                               color_trt = "#05cf99", color_ctrl = "#483d3f", alpha_val = 0.6) {
  
  plot_title <- ifelse(var_name == "distance", 
                       paste("P-Score Overlap -", strata_name, "(Logit)"),
                       paste("Covariate Overlap (", var_name, ") -", strata_name))
  
  bal.plot(match_obj, var.name = var_name, which = "both", type = "density", mirror = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = scales::alpha(color_ctrl, alpha_val), "1" = scales::alpha(color_trt, alpha_val))) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = color_ctrl, "1" = color_trt)) +
    labs(title = plot_title, subtitle = paste("Method:", method_label)) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = font_family) +
    shared_text_theme
}

# 2. Extract Metrics (Helper for Rubin's Calculation)
extrair_metricas_rubin_vr <- function(match_obj, matched_data, method_label) {
  bal <- bal.tab(match_obj, un = FALSE, disp.v.ratio = TRUE)$Balance
  max_smd <- max(abs(bal$Diff.Adj), na.rm = TRUE)
  v_ratios <- bal$V.Ratio.Adj[!is.na(bal$V.Ratio.Adj)]
  v_ratios <- v_ratios[is.finite(v_ratios)]
  max_vr <- ifelse(length(v_ratios) > 0, max(v_ratios), NA)
  min_vr <- ifelse(length(v_ratios) > 0, min(v_ratios), NA)
  
  potential_vars <- c("sexo_harm", "educ_harm", "activity_harm", "has_car", "age_group", "RENDA_SM")
  valid_vars <- potential_vars[sapply(potential_vars, function(v) length(unique(matched_data[[v]])) > 1)]
  form_str <- ifelse(length(valid_vars) > 0, paste("Treated ~", paste(valid_vars, collapse = " + ")), "Treated ~ 1")
  
  mod_ps <- glm(as.formula(form_str), family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = matched_data)
  linear_ps <- predict(mod_ps, type = "link")
  
  var_trt <- var(linear_ps[matched_data$Treated == 1])
  var_ctrl <- var(linear_ps[matched_data$Treated == 0])
  mean_trt <- mean(linear_ps[matched_data$Treated == 1])
  mean_ctrl <- mean(linear_ps[matched_data$Treated == 0])
  
  rubin_b <- abs(mean_trt - mean_ctrl) / sqrt((var_trt + var_ctrl) / 2) * 100
  rubin_r <- var_trt / var_ctrl
  
  return(data.frame(
    Method = method_label,
    Max_SMD = round(max_smd, 3), Min_Var_Ratio = round(min_vr, 3), Max_Var_Ratio = round(max_vr, 3),
    Rubin_B = round(rubin_b, 1), Rubin_R = round(rubin_r, 2)
  ))
}

# 3. Plot Rubin's Metrics 
gerar_plot_rubin <- function(mets, method_label, font_family = "sans", color_bar = "#05cf99") {
  
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    Metric = factor(c("Rubin's B (Target < 25)", "Rubin's R (Target 0.5 - 2.0)"), 
                    levels = c("Rubin's B (Target < 25)", "Rubin's R (Target 0.5 - 2.0)")),
    Value = c(mets$Rubin_B, mets$Rubin_R),
    Target_Min = c(0, 0.5),
    Target_Max = c(25, 2.0),
    Is_Valid = c(mets$Rubin_B < 25, mets$Rubin_R >= 0.5 & mets$Rubin_R <= 2.0)
  )
  
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = "Score", y = Value)) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = Target_Min, ymax = Target_Max), 
              fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = Is_Valid), width = 0.5, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = color_bar, "FALSE" = "#e74c3c")) + 
    geom_text(aes(label = round(Value, 2)), vjust = -0.5, fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
    facet_wrap(~Metric, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(title = paste("Global Balance (Rubin's Metrics) -", method_label), 
         subtitle = "Gray bands denote ideal target zones. Red indicates a threshold failure.",
         y = "Metric Value", x = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = font_family) +
    shared_text_theme +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
}

# 4. Generate Rosenbaum Bounds Data
run_rosenbaum_bounds <- function(matched_data, outcome_var = "TOT_VIAG") {
  if (!"subclass" %in% names(matched_data)) return(NULL)
  paired <- matched_data %>% filter(!is.na(subclass)) %>% arrange(subclass, desc(Treated))
  y_trt <- paired[[outcome_var]][paired$Treated == 1]
  y_ctrl <- paired[[outcome_var]][paired$Treated == 0]
  if(length(y_trt) == length(y_ctrl) && length(y_trt) > 0) {
    return(psens(y_trt, y_ctrl, Gamma = 2, GammaInc = 0.2))
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}

# 5. Plot Rosenbaum Bounds
gerar_plot_rosenbaum <- function(bounds_res, method_label, font_family = "sans", color_bar = "#05cf99") {
  if (is.null(bounds_res)) return(NULL)
  
  bounds_df <- as.data.frame(bounds_res$bounds)
  colnames(bounds_df) <- c("Gamma", "Lower_Bound", "Upper_Bound")
  
  ggplot(bounds_df, aes(x = as.factor(Gamma), y = Upper_Bound)) +
    geom_col(fill = color_bar, alpha = 0.8, width = 0.6, color = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", color = "#e74c3c", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(Upper_Bound, 3)), vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Rosenbaum Bounds (Intensive Margin) -", method_label),
      subtitle = "Dashed red line indicates p = 0.05 threshold.",
      x = "Gamma (Odds of Differential Assignment Due to Unobserved Factors)",
      y = "Upper Bound P-Value"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.05), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = font_family) +
    shared_text_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

# 6. Parallel Trends
gerar_plots_tendencia <- function(strata_data, strata_name, full_data, font_family = "sans",
                                  color_ctrl_full = "#a39a92", color_trt_full = "#77685d", 
                                  color_ctrl_strata = "#483d3f", color_trt_strata = "#05cf99", 
                                  linetype_full = "dashed", linetype_strata = "solid", 
                                  width_strata = 0.8, size_strata = 3, alpha_strata = 1,
                                  y_breaks_ext = waiver(), y_breaks_int = waiver(),
                                  x_breaks = c(1997, 2007, 2017, 2023)) {
  
  full_trend <- full_data %>% mutate(Y_Binary = ifelse(TOT_VIAG > 0, 1, 0)) %>%
    group_by(Year, Treated) %>%
    summarise(Extensive = weighted.mean(Y_Binary, w = FE_PESS, na.rm = TRUE),
              Intensive = weighted.mean(TOT_VIAG, w = FE_PESS, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Grupo = ifelse(Treated == 1, "Treated (Full)", "Control (Full)"), Contexto = "Baseline Global")
  
  strata_trend <- strata_data %>% mutate(Y_Binary = ifelse(TOT_VIAG > 0, 1, 0)) %>%
    group_by(Year, Treated) %>%
    summarise(Extensive = weighted.mean(Y_Binary, w = FE_PESS, na.rm = TRUE),
              Intensive = weighted.mean(TOT_VIAG, w = FE_PESS, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Grupo = ifelse(Treated == 1, paste("Treated", strata_name), paste("Control", strata_name)), Contexto = strata_name)
  
  plot_data <- bind_rows(full_trend, strata_trend)
  
  cores <- setNames(c(color_ctrl_full, color_trt_full, color_ctrl_strata, color_trt_strata),
                    c("Control (Full)", "Treated (Full)", paste("Control", strata_name), paste("Treated", strata_name)))
  linhas <- setNames(c(linetype_full, linetype_strata), c("Baseline Global", strata_name))
  widths <- setNames(c(0.5, width_strata), c("Baseline Global", strata_name))
  sizes <- setNames(c(1.5, size_strata), c("Baseline Global", strata_name))
  alphas <- setNames(c(0.6, alpha_strata), c("Baseline Global", strata_name))
  
  base_plot <- function(y_var, y_label, p_title) {
    ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Year, y = !!sym(y_var), color = Grupo, linetype = Contexto, 
                          linewidth = Contexto, size = Contexto, alpha = Contexto)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 2018, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray50", linewidth = 1) +
      geom_line() + geom_point() +
      scale_color_manual(values = cores) + 
      scale_linetype_manual(values = linhas) +
      scale_linewidth_manual(values = widths) +
      scale_size_manual(values = sizes) +
      scale_alpha_manual(values = alphas, guide = "none") +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks) +
      labs(title = p_title, subtitle = "Parallel Trends Assessment", y = y_label, x = "Year") +
      theme_minimal(base_family = font_family) +
      shared_text_theme
  }
  
  p_ext <- base_plot("Extensive", "How Likely To Make a Trip", paste("Extensive Margin:", strata_name)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), breaks = y_breaks_ext)
  
  p_int <- base_plot("Intensive", "Average Number of Trips (N)", paste("Intensive Margin:", strata_name)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = y_breaks_int)
    
  list(ext = p_ext, int = p_int)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: render-html-tabsets
#| results: "asis"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Define Global Aesthetics Per Match_Type
# ---------------------------------------------------------
match_colors <- c("CEM" = "#05cf99", 
                  "Mahalanobis (1:1)" = "#054dff", "Mahalanobis (1:3)" = "#058ed9", 
                  "Logit (1:1)" = "#EC6F00", "Logit (1:3)" = "#E69F00")

match_alphas <- c("CEM" = 1, 
                  "Mahalanobis (1:1)" = 0.8, "Mahalanobis (1:3)" = 0.8, 
                  "Logit (1:1)" = 0.8, "Logit (1:3)" = 0.8)

match_widths <- c("CEM" = 0.8, 
                  "Mahalanobis (1:1)" = 0.5, "Mahalanobis (1:3)" = 0.5, 
                  "Logit (1:1)" = 0.5, "Logit (1:3)" = 0.5)

match_sizes  <- c("CEM" = 3.5, 
                  "Mahalanobis (1:1)" = 2.5, "Mahalanobis (1:3)" = 2.5, 
                  "Logit (1:1)" = 2.5, "Logit (1:3)" = 2.5)
# ---------------------------------------------------------

strata_keys <- c("Full", "S1_All", "S1_Male", "S1_Female", 
                 "S2_All", "S2_Male", "S2_Female", 
                 "S3_All", "S3_Male", "S3_Female")

cat("::: panel-tabset\n\n")

for (s in strata_keys) {
  cat(paste0("## ", s, "\n\n"))
  
  cat("::: panel-tabset\n\n")
  
  configs <- list(
    list(key = "mah_1", title = "Mahalanobis (1:1)", label = "Mahalanobis (1:1)"),
    list(key = "mah_3", title = "Mahalanobis (1:3)", label = "Mahalanobis (1:3)"),
    list(key = "log_1", title = "Logit (1:1)", label = "Logit (1:1)"),
    list(key = "log_3", title = "Logit (1:3)", label = "Logit (1:3)"),
    list(key = "cem", title = "CEM (Coarsened Exact)", label = "CEM")
  )
  
  for (conf in configs) {
    cat(paste0("### ", conf$title, "\n\n"))
    
    # Extract the dynamic aesthetic profiles for this specific algorithm loop
    exp_data <- experiments[[s]][[conf$key]]
    conf_color <- match_colors[[conf$label]]
    conf_alpha <- match_alphas[[conf$label]]
    conf_width <- match_widths[[conf$label]]
    conf_size  <- match_sizes[[conf$label]]
    
    # 1. Overlap Plot (Treated group gets the dynamic color, Control gets dark gray)
    var_overlap <- ifelse(grepl("log", conf$key), "distance", "RENDA_SM")
    p_dist <- gerar_dist_overlap(exp_data$match_obj, var_overlap, paste(s, conf$title), conf$label, 
                                 font_family = "NHG", color_trt = conf_color, color_ctrl = "#483d3f", alpha_val = conf_alpha)
    print(p_dist)
    cat("\n\n")
    
    # 2. Global Metrics (Rubin's Bar Charts get the dynamic color)
    mets <- extrair_metricas_rubin_vr(exp_data$match_obj, exp_data$matched_data, conf$label)
    p_rubin <- gerar_plot_rubin(mets, conf$label, font_family = "NHG", color_bar = conf_color)
    print(p_rubin)
    cat("\n\n")
    
    # 3. Rosenbaum Bounds (Sensitivity Plot gets the dynamic color)
    bounds_res <- run_rosenbaum_bounds(exp_data$matched_data)
    if (!is.null(bounds_res)) {
      p_rosenbaum <- gerar_plot_rosenbaum(bounds_res, conf$label, font_family = "NHG", color_bar = conf_color)
      print(p_rosenbaum)
    } else {
      cat("> *Note: Rosenbaum bounds calculation via Wilcoxon signed rank requires strict 1:1 paired data. Plot skipped for this ratio/method.*")
    }
    cat("\n\n")
    
    # 4. Love Plot (Adjusted gets the dynamic color, Unadjusted gets gray)
    p_love <- love.plot(exp_data$match_obj, binary = "std", continuous = "std", 
                        abs = TRUE, thresholds = c(m = .1), 
                        colors = c("#a39a92", conf_color), size = conf_size,
                        title = paste("SMD -", s, conf$title)) + 
              theme_minimal(base_family = "NHG") +
              shared_text_theme
    print(p_love)
    cat("\n\n")
    
    # 5. Trend Plots (Matched Treated group gets the dynamic color)
    t_plots <- gerar_plots_tendencia(strata_data = exp_data$matched_data, strata_name = s, 
                                     full_data = experiments$Full[[conf$key]]$matched_data, 
                                     font_family = "NHG",
                                     color_trt_strata = conf_color,
                                     color_ctrl_strata = "#483d3f", # Keeps control group consistent
                                     width_strata = conf_width,
                                     size_strata = conf_size,
                                     alpha_strata = conf_alpha)
    print(t_plots$ext)
    cat("\n\n")
    print(t_plots$int)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
  
  cat(":::\n\n") 
}

cat(":::\n\n")

```

```{r}
#| label: compare-coefficients-vertical
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define Aesthetics Per Match_Type (Edit these!)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
match_colors <- c("CEM" = "#05cf99", 
                  "Mahalanobis (1:1)" = "#054dff", "Mahalanobis (1:3)" = "#058ed9", 
                  "Logit (1:1)" = "#EC6F00", "Logit (1:3)" = "#E69F00")

# Alpha for the connecting lines (0 = invisible, 1 = solid)
match_alphas <- c("CEM" = 1, 
                  "Mahalanobis (1:1)" = 0.4, "Mahalanobis (1:3)" = 0.4, 
                  "Logit (1:1)" = 0.4, "Logit (1:3)" = 0.4)

# Width for the connecting lines
match_widths <- c("CEM" = 0.4, 
                  "Mahalanobis (1:1)" = 0.25, "Mahalanobis (1:3)" = 0.25, 
                  "Logit (1:1)" = 0.25, "Logit (1:3)" = 0.25)

# Sizes for Point Estimates
match_alphas <- c("CEM" = 1, 
                  "Mahalanobis (1:1)" = .6, "Mahalanobis (1:3)" = .6, 
                  "Logit (1:1)" = .6, "Logit (1:3)" = .6)
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# Calculate 95% (1.96) and 90% (1.645) Confidence Intervals
coef_data_flipped <- master_table %>%
  filter(Year == 2023) %>% # Keep only the final treatment year evaluation
  mutate(
    # Extensive Margin CIs
    Ext_CI_95_Low = DiD_Ext_Estimate - (1.96 * DiD_Ext_SE),
    Ext_CI_95_High = DiD_Ext_Estimate + (1.96 * DiD_Ext_SE),
    Ext_CI_90_Low = DiD_Ext_Estimate - (1.645 * DiD_Ext_SE),
    Ext_CI_90_High = DiD_Ext_Estimate + (1.645 * DiD_Ext_SE),
    
    # Intensive Margin CIs
    Int_CI_95_Low = DiD_Int_Estimate - (1.96 * DiD_Int_SE),
    Int_CI_95_High = DiD_Int_Estimate + (1.96 * DiD_Int_SE),
    Int_CI_90_Low = DiD_Int_Estimate - (1.645 * DiD_Int_SE),
    Int_CI_90_High = DiD_Int_Estimate + (1.645 * DiD_Int_SE),
    
    # Standard order for left-to-right plotting
    Strata = factor(Strata, levels = unique(Strata)) 
  )

# 1. Plot Extensive Margin Comparison (Vertical)
p_coef_ext_flip <- ggplot(coef_data_flipped, aes(x = Strata, y = DiD_Ext_Estimate, color = Match_Type, group = Match_Type)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) + 
  
  # Connecting line between means across strata (Aesthetics mapped to Match_Type)
  geom_line(aes(alpha = Match_Type, linewidth = Match_Type), 
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
            
  # 95% CI (Thinner, transparent)
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = Ext_CI_95_Low, ymax = Ext_CI_95_High), 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), linewidth = 0.15, alpha = 0.3) +
  # 90% CI (Thicker, solid)
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = Ext_CI_90_Low, ymax = Ext_CI_90_High), 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  # Point estimate
  geom_point(aes(alpha = Match_Type), position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 1.5) +
             
  # Apply the custom scales
  scale_color_manual(values = match_colors) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = match_alphas, guide = "none") +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = match_widths, guide = "none") +
  
  labs(title = "DiD Coefficient Comparison: Extensive Margin",
       subtitle = "Thick lines denote 90% CI; Thin lines denote 95% CI",
       y = "Treatment Effect Estimate (Probability of making a trip)",
       x = NULL,
       color = "Matching Method") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray30", size = 12),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.22),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14))

# 2. Plot Intensive Margin Comparison (Vertical)
p_coef_int_flip <- ggplot(coef_data_flipped, aes(x = Strata, y = DiD_Int_Estimate, color = Match_Type, group = Match_Type)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  # Connecting line between means across strata (Aesthetics mapped to Match_Type)
  geom_line(aes(alpha = Match_Type, linewidth = Match_Type), 
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
            
  # 95% CI (Thinner, transparent)
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = Int_CI_95_Low, ymax = Int_CI_95_High), 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), linewidth = 0.15, alpha = 0.3) +
  # 90% CI (Thicker, solid)
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = Int_CI_90_Low, ymax = Int_CI_90_High), 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  # Point estimate
  geom_point(aes(alpha = Match_Type), position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 1) +
             
  # Apply the custom scales
  scale_color_manual(values = match_colors) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = match_alphas, guide = "none") +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = match_widths, guide = "none") +
  
  labs(title = "DiD Coefficient Comparison: Intensive Margin",
       subtitle = "Thick lines denote 90% CI; Thin lines denote 95% CI",
       y = "Treatment Effect Estimate",
       x = NULL,
       color = "Matching Method") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray30", size = 12),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.22),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14))

print(p_coef_ext_flip)
print(p_coef_int_flip)

ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", "02_coef_ext_vertical.png"), 
       plot = p_coef_ext_flip, device = "png", units= "mm", width = 183, height = 137, bg = "white")

ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", "02_coef_int_vertical.png"), 
       plot = p_coef_int_flip, device = "png", units= "mm", width = 183, height = 137, bg = "white")
```

```{r}

#| label: export-artefacts
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# 1. Define all strata keys
strata_keys <- c("Full", "S1_All", "S1_Male", "S1_Female", 
                 "S2_All", "S2_Male", "S2_Female", 
                 "S3_All", "S3_Male", "S3_Female")

# 2. Define configurations to map
configs <- list(
  list(key = "mah_1", label = "Mahalanobis (1:1)"),
  list(key = "mah_3", label = "Mahalanobis (1:3)"),
  list(key = "log_1", label = "Logit (1:1)"),
  list(key = "log_3", label = "Logit (1:3)"),
  list(key = "cem", label = "CEM")
)

# Bring in aesthetic definitions to ensure the chunk runs completely standalone
match_colors <- c("CEM" = "#05cf99", "Mahalanobis (1:1)" = "#054dff", "Mahalanobis (1:3)" = "#058ed9", "Logit (1:1)" = "#EC6F00", "Logit (1:3)" = "#E69F00")
match_alphas <- c("CEM" = 1, "Mahalanobis (1:1)" = 0.8, "Mahalanobis (1:3)" = 0.8, "Logit (1:1)" = 0.8, "Logit (1:3)" = 0.8)
match_widths <- c("CEM" = 0.5, "Mahalanobis (1:1)" = 0.5, "Mahalanobis (1:3)" = 0.5, "Logit (1:1)" = 0.5, "Logit (1:3)" = 0.5)
match_sizes  <- c("CEM" = 1.25, "Mahalanobis (1:1)" = 1.25, "Mahalanobis (1:3)" = 1.25, "Logit (1:1)" = 1.25, "Logit (1:3)" = 1.25)

# 3. Loop through and export all plots
for (s in strata_keys) {
  for (conf in configs) {
    
    exp_data <- experiments[[s]][[conf$key]]
    
    # Extract the dynamic aesthetic profiles for this specific algorithm loop
    conf_color <- match_colors[[conf$label]]
    conf_alpha <- match_alphas[[conf$label]]
    conf_width <- match_widths[[conf$label]]
    conf_size  <- match_sizes[[conf$label]]
    
    # A. Export Overlap Plots (Treated gets dynamic color, Control gets dark gray)
    var_overlap <- ifelse(grepl("log", conf$key), "distance", "RENDA_SM")
    p_dist <- gerar_dist_overlap(exp_data$match_obj, var_overlap, paste(s, conf$label), conf$label, 
                                 font_family = "NHG", color_trt = conf_color, color_ctrl = "#483d3f", alpha_val = conf_alpha)
    
    ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", paste0("overlap_", s, "_", conf$key, ".png")), 
           plot = p_dist, device = "png", unit= "mm", width = 183, height = 103, bg = "white")
    
    # B. Export Love Plots (Adjusted gets dynamic color, Unadjusted gets gray)
    p_love <- love.plot(exp_data$match_obj, binary = "std", continuous = "std", 
                        abs = TRUE, thresholds = c(m = .1), 
                        colors = c("#a39a92", conf_color), size = conf_size,
                        title = paste("Balanço SMD -", s, conf$label)) + 
      theme_minimal(base_family = "NHG") +
      shared_text_theme
    
    ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", paste0("love_plot_", s, "_", conf$key, ".png")), 
           plot = p_love, device = "png", unit= "mm", width = 183, height = 103, bg = "white")
    
    # C. Export Global Metrics (Rubin's Plot)
    mets <- extrair_metricas_rubin_vr(exp_data$match_obj, exp_data$matched_data, conf$label)
    p_rubin <- gerar_plot_rubin(mets, conf$label, font_family = "NHG", color_bar = conf_color)
    
    ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", paste0("rubin_metrics_", s, "_", conf$key, ".png")), 
           plot = p_rubin, device = "png", unit= "mm", width = 183, height = 103, bg = "white")
           
    # D. Export Rosenbaum Bounds
    bounds_res <- run_rosenbaum_bounds(exp_data$matched_data)
    if (!is.null(bounds_res)) {
      p_rosenbaum <- gerar_plot_rosenbaum(bounds_res, conf$label, font_family = "NHG", color_bar = conf_color)
      
      ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", paste0("rosenbaum_", s, "_", conf$key, ".png")), 
             plot = p_rosenbaum, device = "png", unit= "mm", width = 183, height = 103, bg = "white")
    }
    
    # E. Export Trend Plots (Matched Treated group gets dynamic color)
    p_trends <- gerar_plots_tendencia(strata_data = exp_data$matched_data, strata_name = s, 
                                     full_data = experiments$Full[[conf$key]]$matched_data, 
                                     font_family = "NHG",
                                     color_trt_strata = conf_color,
                                     color_ctrl_strata = "#483d3f",
                                     width_strata = conf_width,
                                     size_strata = conf_size,
                                     alpha_strata = conf_alpha)
    
    ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", paste0("trend_extensive_", s, "_", conf$key, ".png")), 
           plot = p_trends$ext, device = "png", unit= "mm", width = 183, height = 103, bg = "white")
    
    ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", paste0("trend_intensive_", s, "_", conf$key, ".png")), 
           plot = p_trends$int, device = "png", unit= "mm", width = 183, height = 103, bg = "white")
  }
}

write_csv(master_table, here("outputs", "tables", "master_sample_table-9s.csv"))
message("(EN) All Vector Plots (.png) for the matching methods were exported to 'outputs/'!")
```
